reference: tests/fixtures/dicom-pages/reference (highdicom 0.29.0, pydicom 3.0.2; versions pinned in its uv.lock)
conventions: Geometry in VolView order: dimensions and spacing are [column, row, slice], direction is the column, row and slice axis vectors concatenated, origin is the first voxel centre. A single file keeps stored frame order; one plane has no slice spacing and its slice axis is the plane normal.
pixelEncoding: hash: SHA256 of modality-rescaled samples, rounded through float32 when module.storage is float32, as Float64 little-endian in [slice, row, column] order. stats: per-sample min, max and mean, used for colour and lossy data, compared within statsTolerance.
